versions.changelog:
- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- Updated default model parameter from u1-insuremed to u2-med in documentation.
- No functional logic changes; documentation and packaging only.

- Initial release of the skill for outpatient EMR quality control focusing on detecting inconsistencies between chief complaint and present illness history.
- Supports direct text input and multi-format files (pdf, doc, docx, xls, xlsx, csv, txt, json).
- Calls HiVoice MaaS medical large model (OpenAI-compatible) to output "无缺陷" or "有缺陷 + 原因".
- Implements strict data privacy: requires de-identified input, does not store data after processing.
- Provides CLI with flexible parameters and built-in data preprocessing for various formats.
- All quality control and LLM logic contained in the skill; only requires Python 3.7+ and standard libraries.
